tests.description: DW-81-API-001: existing GET /auth/v1/user returns each authenticated worker identity and valid bootstrap metadata

summary: Generated one P1 API test with two read-only Auth requests. Existing authToken and partnerAuthToken providers supply tokens; TEST_WORKER_INDEX-derived read-only resolution supplies exact independent expected UUID/email identities. The endpoint did not change: this is complementary live identity evidence, not bootstrap or callback-order proof. No production response schema found for /auth/v1/user; a local minimum Zod schema covers identity, audience and metadata fields only. Pact/provider CDC artifacts are outside scope; scrutiny uses installed SDK and repository source, with no claims of remote provider implementation access. No suites were run by the worker. No fixture, source, config, or account mutations. Current docs/changelog were checked under the delegated session Supabase skill; the noted self-hosted SAML API_EXTERNAL_URL change does not alter this existing client /auth/v1/user path.
